title: 第1519章 今夜你睡外面守门正好有妖怪来烈火焚烧第1518章 你是大唐来的取经和尚又哭又闹终于得逞
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 僧人应了一声，走到唐僧面前，做了一个请的手势。
唐僧起身，朝金池长老合十行了一礼，跟着那僧人离开了正殿。
孙悟空从柱子上直起身来，跟在他后面，走出去的时候回头看了一眼金池长老。
他感觉这个和尚似乎有些问题。
但是他也看唐僧不顺眼。
懒得理会这件事情！
金池长老正低着头，双手捧着那件袈裟，像是在端详上面的纹路。
烛光从侧面照过来，他苍老的手指沿着袈裟边缘的金线轻轻摩挲了一下，动作轻柔得有些反常，像是在确认一件属于他自己的东西终于回到了正确的人手上。
“这是我的东西……”
“明明这一切都是我的，结果被这该死的小偷给偷走了！
殿门在唐僧身后关上了。
金池长老抬起头来。
他脸上的泪痕还在，但眼泪已经停了。
他看着紧闭的殿门，沉默了几息，然后把袈裟和锡杖放在身边的蒲团上，转过身，朝殿内那些还低着头的僧人低声说了一句。
“按照计划做。”
说这句话的时候。
金池的声音很冷漠，没有哭腔，没有哽咽，像刚刚什么都没有发生过。
殿内的烛火摇了一下，又恢复了稳定。
唯有他那影子，似乎被什么东西拉的无比斜长，令人感到有种毛骨悚然的诡异！
东边那间独院在观音禅寺的最深处，离正殿隔了两道院墙和一条石径。
院墙是青砖砌的，不高，墙头上爬着几株枯藤，叶子已经落了大半，剩下几片干枯的叶片在夜风中轻轻晃动。
院门是木制的，门板上刷了一层暗红色的漆，漆面已经斑驳，露出了下面灰白色的木质。
门环是铁铸的，上面锈迹斑斑，摸上去有些粗糙。
唐僧跟在那个年轻僧人后面，走进院子的时候，脚步顿了一下。
院子不大，但收拾得很干净。
地面铺着青石板，缝隙里填着细沙，踩上去没有尘土扬起。
靠墙种着一丛竹子，竹竿细瘦，在夜风中发出细微的沙沙声，竹叶的影子在月光下摇晃，映在青砖墙面上，像一幅墨色的画。
墙角还放着一口大水缸，缸沿上搭着一只木瓢，水面在月光下泛着银白色的光，映出旁边竹枝的轮廓。
年轻僧人推开正屋的门，侧身让开，“长老请进，屋里已经收拾好了。”
唐僧跨过门槛，借着月光打量了一圈。
屋子不大，但陈设齐全。
靠窗摆着一张木床，床上铺着干净的褥子和薄被，枕头是荞麦壳的，拍上去软硬适中。
床头的矮几上放着一盏油灯，灯盏里添满了灯油，旁边还搁着一根火折子。
靠墙有一张方桌，桌上摆着茶壶和两只倒扣的茶杯，茶壶是粗陶的，壶身带着细密的冰裂纹，像是用了很多年但养护得宜。
墙角放着一个脸盆架，架子上搭着一条叠好的布巾。
唐僧站在屋中央，看着这间干净整洁的房间，伸手摸了摸被褥，干燥，有阳光晒过的味道。
他长长地舒了一口气。
“悟空。”
他转头看向跟在身后的孙悟空，语气里带着几分得意的轻松，“你看，这老住持对贫僧还是相当敬重的，方才在前殿虽然有些言语上的冲撞，但那是误会，解开就好了，贫僧就说嘛，贫僧到底是佛祖钦点的取经人，走到哪里都会有人敬着。”
他说话的时候，目光落在孙悟空身上，像是在等一个回应。
content_en:
"Yes!"
The monk responded, walked up to Tang Monk, and made a gesture of invitation.
Tang Monk stood up, put his hands together and saluted Elder Jinchi, and followed the monk out of the main hall.
Sun Wukong straightened up from the pillar and followed him. When he walked out, he looked back at Elder Jinchi.
He felt that there seemed to be something wrong with this monk.
But he also disliked Tang Seng.
Too lazy to pay attention to this matter!
Elder Jinchi was lowering his head and holding the cassock in both hands, as if he was studying the lines on it.
The candlelight shone from the side, and his old fingers gently rubbed along the golden thread on the edge of the cassock. The movement was so gentle that it was abnormal, as if he was confirming that something belonging to him had finally returned to the right person.
"This is my thing..."
"Obviously all this is mine, but it was stolen by this damn thief!
! "
The palace door was closed behind Tang Seng.
Elder Jinchi raised his head.
The tears on his face were still there, but the tears had stopped.
He looked at the closed door of the temple and was silent for a few breaths. Then he put his cassock and tin staff on the futon beside him, turned around, and whispered to the monks who still had their heads lowered in the temple.
"Follow the plan."
when saying this.
Jin Chi's voice was very indifferent, without crying or choking, as if nothing had happened just now.
The candlelight in the hall flickered and became stable again.
Only his shadow seemed to be stretched extremely long and diagonally by something, which made people feel creepy and weird!
The single courtyard to the east is in the deepest part of Guanyin Temple, separated from the main hall by two courtyard walls and a stone path.
The courtyard wall is made of green bricks and is not high. There are a few dead vines climbing on the wall. Most of the leaves have fallen off, and a few dry leaves are left swaying gently in the night wind.
The courtyard door is made of wood, and the door panel is painted with a layer of dark red paint. The paint surface is mottled, revealing the gray-white wood underneath.
The door knocker was made of iron, rusty and rough to the touch.
Tang Seng followed the young monk and paused when he walked into the courtyard.
The yard is not big, but it is very clean.
The ground is paved with bluestone slabs, and the gaps are filled with fine sand. There is no dust raised when you step on it.
There is a clump of bamboo planted against the wall. The bamboo poles are thin and make a subtle rustling sound in the night wind. The shadows of the bamboo leaves sway in the moonlight and are reflected on the blue brick wall, like an ink painting.
There is also a large water tank in the corner, with a wooden ladle placed on the edge of the tank. The water surface glows silvery white in the moonlight, reflecting the outline of the bamboo branches next to it.
The young monk pushed open the door of the main room and stepped aside. "Elder, please come in. The room has been tidied up."
Tang Monk crossed the threshold and looked around in the moonlight.
The room is not big, but fully furnished.
There is a wooden bed by the window. The bed is covered with clean mattresses and thin quilts. The pillows are made of buckwheat shells and appear to be moderately soft and hard.
There was an oil lamp placed on the low table at the head of the bed. The lamp was filled with lamp oil, and there was a fire stick beside it.
There is a square table against the wall. On the table are a teapot and two upside-down teacups. The teapot is made of rough pottery, with fine ice cracks on the body, as if it has been used for many years but has been properly maintained.
There was a washbasin stand in the corner, and a folded cloth towel was placed on the stand.
Tang Seng stood in the middle of the room, looking at the clean and tidy room. He reached out and touched the bedding. It was dry and smelled of sunlight.
He breathed a long sigh of relief.
"Wukong."
He turned to look at Sun Wukong who was following behind him, and said with a bit of complacency in his tone, "You see, this old abbot still respects the poor monk. Although there was some verbal conflict in the front hall just now, it was a misunderstanding. Just clear it up. The poor monk just said that the poor monk is the person who has been appointed by the Buddha to learn scriptures, and there will be people respecting him wherever he goes."
When he spoke, his eyes fell on Sun Wukong, as if waiting for a response.
title_en: Chapter 1519: Tonight you sleep outside and guard the door. Monsters come and burn you with fire. Chapter 1518: You are a Buddhist monk from the Tang Dynasty. You cried and made trouble and finally succeeded.
